image_description: A high-angle, close-up shot of a Nile crocodile partially submerged in murky water. The view focuses on the dorsal surface, showing the head, neck, and upper back. The skin is heavily textured with bony scutes (osteoderms). The snout is visible at the bottom center, pointing downwards. A wooden stick or branch is visible in the upper left background.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The snout is clearly visible and tapers to a point, consistent with the V-shape characteristic of crocodiles rather than the U-shape of alligators.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth is tightly closed and the angle/position makes it impossible to see the teeth or the interlocking pattern.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While the eye bumps are visible, the eyes themselves appear closed or obscured by the angle and lighting; pupils and membranes are not discernible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Two distinct nostril openings are visible at the very tip of the snout.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the body shows heavy armor plating typical of crocodilians.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinct rows of raised, bony scutes run down the spine and back, matching the description perfectly.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coloration is earthy brown/grey and the texture is visibly rough and granular.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The animal is viewed from above (dorsal view); the belly (ventral surface) is completely hidden by the body and water.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Limbs are not visible in this frame; they are likely tucked under the body or submerged.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Only the anterior portion of the body is visible; the tail extends out of the frame.
